item.title: Potter Park Zoo's 16-year-old tiger dies
item.description: LANSING, Mich. (WLNS) -- Potter Park Zoo announced Monday that Vikentii, a 16-year-old Amur tiger, has been humanely euthanized. The tiger experienced a sudden decline in mobility, determined to be related to neurological factors. Vikentii had surpassed the median life expectancy for Amur tigers living in human care. item.title: 'We're going for a ride now': How survivors rode out the Union Lake tornado
